blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – House Speaker Faustino “Bojie” Dy III on Monday evening said the lower chamber boosted funding for vital agricultural programs to help the food sector prepare for a looming “Super El Niño.” The House of Representatives added P4.09 billion in irrigation funding and another P500 million for fertilizer assistance to farmers, Dy told the floor, according to a Tuesday statement. Lawmakers also earmarked P4.96 billion in extra funding for farm-to-market roads and P150 million for agricultural transport infrastructure to support logistics expansion, he said.
